title: Learning from Crowds with Unsupervised Item Response Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.34602v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Item Response Theory (IRT) is the study of tests, including the properties of both test items and test takers. Crowdsourced labelling can be cast as an unsupervised IRT problem: annotators play the role of test takers with varying ability, and annotation tasks play the role of items with varying difficulty. We evaluate unsupervised variants of standard logistic IRT models for latent trait recovery and label inference on six datasets with crowdsourced labels and known ground truths. Unsupervised IRT models can recover annotator and item traits (e.g., ability, difficulty and discrimination) reliably across most datasets when compared to supervised variants trained on the ground truth. IRT models seem to be more stable in label inference compared to most baselines, but might not be the best possible choice depending on the dataset. translated_title: 基于无监督项目反应模型的群体学习
translated_abstract: 项目反应理论（IRT）是研究测试的学科，涵盖测试题目与受试者的属性。众包标注可以被建模为一个无监督的IRT问题：标注者扮演能力各异的受试者角色，标注任务则扮演难度不同的题目角色。我们在六个包含众包标签和已知真实标签的数据集上，评估了标准逻辑IRT模型的无监督变体在潜在特质恢复和标签推断方面的表现。与基于真实标签训练的有监督变体相比，无监督IRT模型在大多数数据集上都能可靠地恢复标注者和题目的特质（如能力、难度和区分度）。与大多数基线方法相比，IRT模型在标签推断方面似乎更为稳定，但依据数据集的不同，它未必是最佳选择。我们进一步提出在分类器训练过程中利用IRT模型提供指导，并与现有的众包方法进行比较。
tldr: 本文将众包标注建模为无监督项目反应理论（IRT）问题，证明无监督IRT模型能够可靠恢复标注者与题目的潜在特质并实现稳定的标签推断，还提出在分类器训练中利用IRT模型提供指导。
en_tdlr: This paper casts crowdsourced labelling as an unsupervised Item Response Theory problem, showing that unsupervised IRT models reliably recover annotator and item traits with stable label inference, and further uses IRT models to inform classifier training.
